extDescription.message: Hover any price on any page to see it in your own currency.

baseCurrencyHelp.message: Prices already in this currency are left alone.

convertToHelp.message: Shown in the tooltip, under your own currency.

cryptoEnabledHelp.message: Adds 24 assets. Rates from api.coingecko.com, contacted hourly only while this is on.

cryptoDenied.message: Crypto stays off without access to api.coingecko.com.

ratesStale.message: Rates may be out of date

saveFailed.message: Your change could not be saved.

loadFailed.message: Your settings could not be read, so nothing will be saved. Try again in a moment.

tooltipInferred.message: Currency read from the site, not from the price

hoverDelayHelp.message: Pointer stillness before the tooltip opens. Longer means fewer flashing past.

roundingHelp.message: A converted price is an estimate. Fewer digits say so.

inlineModeHelp.message: Your currency beside every price, no hover needed. Hover still opens the list.

inlineStyleHelp.message: Replacing hides the site’s price without deleting it. Hover shows it again.

pageContext.message: Read $$, kr and ¥ from the site

pageContextHelp.message: On .ca, $$ is Canadian. A table row or a page that names its currency (CNY, CAD) is believed, and the page is remembered for the site. Off, only your locks apply.

enabledEverywhereHelp.message: Off means PriceHover does nothing on any page.

invalidSite.message: That is not a site address. Try example.com.

lockedSitesHelp.message: On these sites the symbol always means the currency you chose, whatever the page suggests.

learnedSitesHelp.message: The currency a site’s own pages named, remembered on this device only. The domain and your locks come first.

resetWarning.message: This clears every setting, including your paused and locked sites and what sites taught it. It cannot be undone.

privacyNote.message: One host for rates, open.er-api.com. What you browse never leaves your browser.

welcomeBody.message: Pick your currency, then hover a price.

pageAccessBody.message: Your browser is holding back access to the sites you visit, so no price is detected anywhere. Grant it, then reload the tabs you already have open.
